freezeAuthorization: Root authorized historical reveal after the Solver revision and independent QA were frozen.

comparisons.rootCause: MATCH: an unanchored /---+(=|$)/ guard can match a run of three or more hyphens anywhere in the normalized token, misclassifying otherwise valid content as an empty option name.
comparisons.behavior: MATCH: both revisions add the same start anchor, restricting the invalid-empty-name guard to leading hyphen-only spellings while allowing trailing hyphens in valid option names and values.
comparisons.tests: COMPLEMENTARY: the accepted patch adds one string-input test for quoted and equals-assigned values ending in three hyphens. The replay adds two tests covering option names ending in three/four hyphens plus bare -, --, ordinary dashed names and invalid empty names. Independent QA further covers empty assigned values, internal triple-hyphen sequences and unknown-options-as-args. The replay production blob is identical to accepted, so accepted value scenarios follow the same corrected path.
comparisons.scope: PRODUCTION MATCH: both change the same single character in lib/yargs-parser.ts. Replay test scope is broader (22 added lines versus accepted 7) but remains confined to the parser regression and neighboring hyphen behavior.
comparisons.simplicity: MATCH: the implementation is exactly the accepted one-character regex anchor; no new abstraction, dependency or API surface.
comparisons.regressions: No observed regression. CommonJS, ESM, TypeScript compilation/build, behavioral TypeScript tests, StandardX and independent boundary probes pass. Browser tests and the historical Node matrix remain unexecuted but are not implicated by the parser-only change.

limitations: The replay does not persist the accepted patch's exact quoted-value examples, although the production change is byte-identical and the full parser suites plus broader QA pass.
Node.js 24.19.0 on Linux only; the historical Node matrix was not run.
Historical dependency ranges required installation-only compatibility pins, and the Puppeteer browser suite was not run.
